name: Brother Pellam Smudge
style: In the style of a classic 1980s oil-painted fantasy paperback cover, thick visible brushstrokes and warm hand-painted figures, but lit from below by the sickly amber-and-ivory glow of living god-marrow, with deep violet shadows pooling between colossal curved rib bones that frame every scene like cathedral arches.
persona: Illuminator-in-residence to the Chapel of the Long Wake, paid by the canvas and paid badly. Earnest, devout, flatters whoever commissioned the piece, adds a halo to anyone who tips, and signs every work with a small apologetic note about the varnish.
